buckets.title: Fitness & Fatigue
buckets.text: Freshness points fairly clearly to Podoroska. Workload tilts to Podoroska: 40 games in the last fortnight to Gormaz's 118. Over the last 7 days it is 3 matches for Gormaz against 2 for Podoroska.

buckets.title: Motivation & Pressure
buckets.text: Gormaz gets a slim nod on motivation and pressure. Both are gaining ground, but Gormaz faster: +125 Elo over 90 days against +78 for Podoroska. Deciding-set record under pressure: Gormaz 58%, Podoroska 29%. Offsetting that, Podoroska is playing at home in Buenos Aires, Argentina, and the crowd should help with the big points.

buckets.title: Conditions
buckets.text: Gormaz holds a clear advantage on conditions. Gormaz has 23 matches on Clay in the last 90 days, Podoroska only 10, so the adjustment period is shorter. On Clay, Gormaz has won 68% over the past year (53 matches) to Podoroska's 58% (12).
